title: Polynomial-time computability of a bit predicate
statement: For every finite bit string $w$, the function that outputs the one-bit string $[b]$, where $b$ is true exactly when the bits of $w$ at positions $1$, $2$, and $3$ are all false (with a missing bit treated as false), is polynomial-time computable.
